Bring your feeds in

Most readers export your subscriptions as an OPML file — look for Import/Export in their settings. Folders come across as folders.
Subscription listAn .opml or .xml file exported from FreshRSS, Feedly, Inoreader, NewsBlur, or anything else that speaks OPML.
Importing subscribes you straight away — a list of 150 feeds takes about a second. The articles arrive behind it as the poller reaches each feed, so a feed showing nothing yet is not a feed that failed.

Take them with you

Your subscriptions are yours. This writes the same kind of file you brought in, and any other reader can read it.
Your feedsDownloads an OPML file with your feeds and their folders.
Feeds and folders only — not the articles, and not your notes, ratings or tags.
